topology_note: MLS1 is a Layer 3 switch (3560) with SVIs for VLANs 10, 20, and 30. VLAN 30 ports are on Fa0/15-Fa0/18. ip routing is enabled.
expected_fault: The SVI for VLAN 30 has IP address 10.10.30.2 but the PCs are configured with default gateway 10.10.30.1. No device owns 10.10.30.1 so the gateway is unreachable.
